text: Spider-Man locomotion: swing between skyscrapers using both controllers as arms
description: No automatic flight; movement only from controller input. Each controller shoots a web or grapple at a building and hangs from it like a pendulum, while arm pulls add momentum. Release to fly ballistically, then grab the next roof. The city is procedural skyscraper blocks (grid ID, Gaussian height falloff around the player), so there are always anchors nearby.

status.comment: Swing mode (switch `swing`, fader `reel`, branch experiments): the trigger anchors a rope of the grab distance (block hit, or ZIP_ANYWHERE point), reeling in at reel m/s down to 1.5 m; gravity on; one-sided rope constraint (swing::rope) per hand, both hands at once; release = ballistic flight, drag fader for air damping. Verified: unit test (10 m rope from horizontal swings through the bottom at ~14 m/s within 3 s, never leaves the rope sphere; slack rope no-op), app builds and runs in dev.sh. Not yet: arm-pull momentum (controller velocity), feel-tested in a headset — needs Felix to try it with swing=on.
